quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia IR presentation: Q3 2026 Financial Results (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nokia Q3 2026 results deck (cover dated 22 October 2026): net sales EUR 5.2bn, +9% year on year at constant currency (+10% reported); comparable gross margin 44.6% and operating margin 11.7% (+220 bps); free cash flow EUR -0.1bn and net cash EUR 2.6bn. AI & Cloud net sales grew 123% with AI & Cloud order intake of €1.5bn in Q3; Telecom +0%, Mission Critical Enterprise & Defense +7%, Technology Licensees +8%. Network Infrastructure +15%: Optical Networks EUR 933 million (+18%), IP Networks EUR 839 million (+43%), Fixed Networks EUR 386 million (-22%); Mobile Infrastructure +5% (Radio Networks EUR 1 958 million +10%, Core Software EUR 519 million -13%, Technology Standards EUR 425 million +8%).
quarterly_data.figure: Q3 net sales EUR 5.2bn (+9%); AI & Cloud order intake €1.5bn, net sales +123%; Optical Networks EUR 933 million (+18%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Nokia IR presentation: Q3 2026 Financial Results (10-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Nokia Q3 2026 results deck, products and capacity: 800G coherent pluggable shipments up 2.4x quarter on quarter; 800G ZR/ZR+ pluggable design wins with 29 customers; a major hyperscaler line system win; multi-rail with 3 design wins and initial customer deliveries; IP Networks 2 hyperscaler design wins including a next-gen DC gateway, and work with Zayo and neocloud partners on a new inference connectivity architecture; Fab 2 in San Jose moving to 24/7 operations by end of October. AI-RAN: 19 customers engaged, the platform deployed in live networks with T-Mobile and Elisa, and >20% spectral-efficiency gains in first proofs.
quarterly_data.figure: 800G pluggable shipments +2.4x QoQ; 29 ZR/ZR+ design-win customers; 19 AI-RAN customers
